scope.head: b765b55cca0e1eaacebc738a68de77906bb50756
scope.range: b765b55cca0e1eaacebc738a68de77906bb50756 plus current Stage B working-tree runtime migration and focused regression changes

findings.title: Reject an unsupported negotiated ACP version before submitting work
findings.trigger: A selected ACP candidate responds to initialize with protocolVersion 2 while this transport requires stable v1. This was reproduced with the unchanged real public entry, pinned ACPX 0.13.2, and the existing fake-acp-agent.cjs wrong-version scenario.
findings.impact: The real entry still sends session/new and session/prompt and returns completed/end_turn. These lines then assign protocolVersion 1 without observing negotiation; delegate-worker.cjs publishes that value as acp_protocol_version. A finished model result with clean changed paths and a stopped worker can consequently satisfy acp-conformance.cjs:210-217 for a candidate that never negotiated the required version. This loses the previous pre-work version refusal and permits false v1 conformance evidence.
findings.evidence: At HEAD b765b55, acp-driver.cjs:668-670 rejected initialized.protocolVersion !== ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION before session/new. The migrated real entry at /tmp/ubp-acpx-runtime-ppTQ/runtime/acpx_delegate_entry.cjs (SHA-256 99049a249b8bf719914601cb82869692379e5a8bba8fff1ad51d796fe5a4c6bb, equal to the maintained source before and after the diagnostic) relies on ensureSession and reaches startTurn without that check. Existing tests/fixtures/fake-acp-agent.cjs:129 (SHA-256 3be19ae9c04ff7bac9872f74d48b901eefc5737910cfa6a3b494150c3e3c0844) returns version 2 for the retained fixture-config.json wrong-version input. In .ultra/.runtime/owner-factory-implementation-20260905/stage-b-wrong-version-review/, agent-trace.jsonl:1-3 records initialize, session/new and session/prompt (SHA-256 fd2387dcfa953044095616a5e8c00a4b4a643f42919adaf3b3d1762fdf0db624); stdout.jsonl:6 records completed/end_turn (SHA-256 fd14a01c6816dd04ae3c6898ce032ac941b29cbac819bc538f38297e1b2712d3), with exit code 0 and empty stderr. request.json SHA-256 is 7c1fe76b3744657741cbb6b85c5fa345e85310089f3b118589c5de233298bb62 and fixture-config.json SHA-256 is 2eac4a3e2866a56307ee5cc6684d9a2e0a36e543c10c98e2ecdfefa5a195a0d8. observation.json retains the exact operational command and limits. The trace does not log Agent response bytes; the version-2 response is established by that exact unchanged fixture and input. The UBP publication and possible conformance acceptance are source-traced through delegate-worker.cjs:360,198 and acp-conformance.cjs:210-217,235, not claimed as a separate full conformance run. The current wrong-version unit case uses fake-acpx-entry.cjs, whose own version comparison masks this omission in the real entry.
findings.suggestion: Keep the public ACPX runtime and restore the required version check at its consumer boundary using the actual negotiated protocol value exposed by the existing runtime/session-store contract. Refuse unsupported or unproven negotiation before startTurn, and make UBP consume that observation instead of synthesizing 1 from any result line. Do not rebuild a second protocol engine. The minimum acceptance is the same real-entry wrong-version input yielding a typed failure with no session/prompt, no successful v1 claim and no conformance pass, while a version-1 normal turn, pre-prompt auth fallback and cancellation retain their existing behavior.

positive_observations: The launcher sends envViews.worker to the actual detached spawn; the worker rebuilds the entry/Host environment from the digest-bound env_keys and explicit delegateEnv. The public entry inherits this scoped environment and the actual launched entry PID is recorded as the writer-tree root.

signalOutcome treats only ESRCH as dead, EPERM as alive and other signal failures as unknown. Outer-worker status/cancel and inner-writer recovery retain unproven locks and fences; an outcome_unknown result remains frozen until matching current inner and outer stop proof permits explicit recovery.

The ACP-to-CLI fallback requires the structured ensure_session phase plus a proven-stopped first writer before rewinding the observation. Missing, unknown and turn phases do not authorize replay. The real entry derives the phase from the startTurn call boundary rather than authentication message wording.

Permission decisions select the first offered allow_once only for already authorized operations and locations. Denials are journaled while later bounded probes remain reachable; cancellation and late terminal lines do not themselves release a writer fence.
The repaired ZCode bridge marker is distinct from the retained negative qualification identity. The old record remains bound to the old build and cannot qualify the repaired build by implication.

The retained final root release record reports exit code 0, with all 171 source hashes unchanged before/after. Every packet diff file represented in that record still matched the recorded source hash during this review. The raw index retains the earlier failed full release and later corrected run; these successful suites did not cover the newly reproduced real-entry wrong-version path.
limitations: This lens did not rerun full suites, call any Provider, install a Host, commit, change task status or edit implementation/tests. Root explicitly extended its read-only authority for one existing-program protocol diagnostic and its retained JSON inputs/observations/raw logs.

Actual Host enforcement qualification, qualification-kit work and Task 2 acceptance are outside this packet. The directed diagnostic used the real public entry and pinned runtime with the existing local fake Agent only.

The public entry and pinned SDK implementation were inspected only as necessary consumers of the packet runtime diff. They are external source evidence, not additional files claimed in scope.files_analyzed.

The SDK advertises client fs/terminal capabilities while deny-all rejects their operations. The matching installed claude-agent-acp 0.70.0 source did not establish a reachable native-tool diversion, so this review does not elevate that existing equivalence limitation into an unproven P1. Per-message session identity equivalence and cross-platform Host behavior likewise remain unverified.

No complete boundary-stop or real Host qualification claim is inferred from the directed entry diagnostic. Its observed completed terminal establishes the protocol regression; downstream UBP/conformance impact was traced in source.
